source: Ten bundled CDDA firearms, AIR capacities and combat balance; ammunition families are 9mm and shot. Integral game magazines abstract detachable magazines.

magazines.//: Prologue rule (01.10.2026): a magazine, clip or speedloader is a loader, not a store. One that fits the gun (byGun, read from the CDDA magazine wells and speedloader lists), carried anywhere, makes a reload take reloadFactor of the gun's reloadCost; one whose capacity is above the gun's stated capacity lets the gun hold that many.

fittings.//: Prologue rule (01.10.2026), game code src/game/combat/Fittings.js. A gun or a bow holds one fitting to a slot. byId: slot; skills (the ranged skills of the weapons it goes on) or guns (named weapons only); accuracy is added to the aim; steadiness is taken off the aim lost per step of distance; range in steps; damage and reloadFactor multiply; fireCost is added to the move points of a shot; catchBrass sends the spent case to the pack. Slots and targets follow the CDDA gunmod location and mod_targets; the numbers are Prologue balance.
